basic_info.description:
Two bedroom Two bath unit. Private balcony. Tons of storage. Walk-in closets. High end finishes and top grade appliances. Upgraded with custom shades throughout home.

Conveniently located in the heart of the city in the Upper Market Corridor, LINEA is completed with modern steel and glass designed exterior, clean lines and minimalistic high-end finishes in the units. A welcoming lobby attendant provides extra security and convenience to receive packages for you while you are away. Lounge at the rooftop sky terrace and entertain and BBQ while enjoying sweeping city views. 

LINEA is situated on the border of Hayes Valley and Mission Dolores giving you easy access to Dolores Park and the best restaurants in San Francisco or nightlife in the Duboce Triangle and Castro. Located next to Safeway, Whole Foods, Starbucks, Jamba Juice and many more.

Across the street from Google Shuttle and minutes from Apple/Facebook/LinkedIn Shuttles. Or hop on the Muni lines all within on block.

Washer/Dryer in-unit. Liebherr Refrigerator. Bosch Dishwasher. Bertazzoni Gas stove and oven.

Owner pays water, gas, garbage, sewer, maintenance fees.
Tenant pays electricity, optional cable/tv/internet.
Parking: Street Parking Only
